purpose: CPU serialization cost; no model quality measured

format_system_prompts.space: Output only the answer grid. Each row is digits 0-9 separated by single spaces. Put one row on each line. Do not write an explanation.
format_system_prompts.compact: Output only the answer grid. Each row is digits 0-9 without spaces. Put one row on each line. Do not write an explanation.
format_system_prompts.rle: Output only the answer grid in row run-length format. Write each run as color:count, separate runs by single spaces, and put one row on each line. Colors are digits 0-9. Do not write an explanation.
